description: Spreads the channels of a polyphonic cable across the stereo field, giving each channel its own random position.

params.text: Sets the widest random position allowed, 0% at the centre to 100% across the full stereo field, and attenuates the spread CV input.
Moves the positions over time: negative settings drift each channel towards the side it was given, positive settings drift them towards the centre.
Sets the level of both outputs, from silence to plus 6dB.

inputs.text: Sets the widest random position allowed by voltage, 0-10V for the full stereo field, attenuated by the SPREAD knob; with nothing patched the module reads 10V here.
Sets each channel's position from an outside voltage, 0-10V, when the distribution is set to External; monophonic or polyphonic.
The polyphonic signal to be panned.
A trigger gives every channel a new random position; with a polyphonic trigger only the channels that receive one are moved.

outputs.text: The left side of the panned signal, summed to one channel unless the menu keeps it polyphonic.
The right side of the panned signal, summed to one channel unless the menu keeps it polyphonic.

notes: every channel starts in the centre and stays there until a trigger arrives at TRIG; the SPREAD knob and the DIST input are read at that moment only.
menu: Distribution — Normal favours the centre, Normal mirrored favours the edges, Uniform spreads evenly, and External takes each channel's position from the DIST input.
Polyphonic output — keeps the two outputs polyphonic instead of summing each to one channel.
